metadata.name: Naive CD4+ T cell
metadata.description: An antigen inexperienced CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive and CD62L-positive. This cell type develops in the thymus. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high, and CD44-low.

synonyms.synonym: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte
